note: Freshness of every act in this repository: when it was last checked against the Official Gazette, how, and whether a known change is missing. One row per act in data/freshness/<kind>/<year>.csv (listed in data/freshness/index.json); acts of the first build (root laws.csv) are identified by their folder, the others by their id (registry/data/paths.json). `python tools/freshness.py <act id or folder>` reads them. A status is as of `as_of`; an act verified longer ago than its threshold has since become stale. Kosovo's record is as enacted: an act the Gazette links as amended is pending-change ("amended, not consolidated") until a consolidated text is published and applied.

statuses.current: checked against the official source within its threshold, and no known change is missing
statuses.pending-change: the official source reports a change (amendment, repeal) this repository does not have as a consolidated text: the act is held as enacted (or as last consolidated) and labelled
statuses.unverified: never checked against the official source for later changes
statuses.source-unavailable: due for a check, but the official source has not answered the latest checks

methods.gazette-record: the act's page at the Official Gazette (gzk.rks-gov.net/ActDetail.aspx: its status and its links to the acts that amend, supplement or repeal it), read that day, and the Gazette's list of consolidated texts, compared with what this repository holds

national.label: Constitution, codes, laws, international agreements, Government decisions and decrees

secondary.label: administrative instructions, regulations, statutes, orders, declarations, and the Constitutional Court's judgments, decisions and opinions

final: An act repealed here (its files deleted on the repealing act's in-force day) no longer changes: it stays current once checked, with no threshold (its check_due is empty).

columns.act: the act id (data/paths.json maps it to its folder)
columns.last_verified: the day of the last check that confirmed the latest version held here is the newest (UTC)
columns.check_due: last_verified plus the threshold: after this day the act is stale unless checked again
columns.newest_change: the newest change the official sources report (an act, by its official title)
columns.newest_change_date: its day (its Gazette issue day where known)
columns.change_in_repo: yes if this repository has that change applied to the act's text, no if not
columns.official_url: the act's page at its official source, to check by hand

sources.source: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (gzk.rks-gov.net), act pages
